meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: DNAnexus cloud genomics platform. Build apps/applets, manage data (upload/download), dxpy Python SDK, run workflows, FASTQ/BAM/VCF, for genomics pipeline development and execution.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus云上构建和运行基因组学分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上开发基因组学应用或管理测序数据
copy.tagline_en: Build and run genomics pipelines on the DNAnexus cloud platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop genomics apps or manage sequencing data on DNAnexus

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你管理 DNAnexus 云基因组平台：上传/下载文件、构建和运行 app/applet、使用 dxpy Python SDK 编写脚本、处理 FASTQ/BAM/VCF 等生物信息数据。
howto.when: 当你需要创建或修改 DNAnexus 应用、管理数据对象、运行分析作业或编写 dxpy 脚本时触发。

say.text: 帮我上传 sample.fastq 到项目 project-xxxx。
创建一个 app，输入 FASTQ 文件，输出过滤后的 reads。
say.note: Claude 会生成 app 骨架和入口点代码。

say.text: 查找项目里所有 BAM 文件并下载。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage the DNAnexus cloud genomics platform: upload/download files, build and run apps/applets, use the dxpy Python SDK, and process bioinformatics data like FASTQ, BAM, VCF.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or modify DNAnexus apps, manage data objects, run analysis jobs, or write dxpy scripts.

say_en.text: Create an app that takes a FASTQ file and outputs filtered reads.
say_en.note: Claude will generate app skeleton and entry point code.

say_en.text: Find all BAM files in the project and download them.
say_en.note: Claude will use find_data_objects and download_dxfile.
